spans.s:
mfn. (-धुः-ध्वी-धु)
Sweet, literally or figuratively.
n. (-धु)
1 Spirituous liquor, distilled from the blossoms of the Bassia latifolia, or according to some explanations wine, or spirit distilled from grapes.
2

Honey.
3

The nectar, or honey of flowers.
4

Water.
5

Milk.
6

Sugar.
7

Sweetness, in flavour, sound, or disposition.
m. (-धुः)
1 The month Chaitra, (March-April.)
2 The season of spring.
3 A tree, (Bassia latifolia.)
4 The name of a Daitya or demon, slain by VIṢṆ

The Aśoka tree, (Jonesia asoca.)
6

Liquorice.
7

The name of a RĀKṢASA killed by ŚATRUGHNA.
f. (-धुः)
A plant, (Celtis orientalis.)
E.
मन to mind or respect, Uṇādi aff. उ, and ध substituted for the final.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Sweet, (in taste.)
2 Sweet speaking, or sounding, mellifluous, melodious.
m. (-कः)
1 A bard, a panegyrist, one who recites the lineage and praises of sovereigns in their presence.
2 A bird.
2 A tree, (Bassia latifolia.)
mn. (-कः-कं)
Liquorice, &c.
n. (-कं)
Tin.
f. (-का)
1 A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.)
2 The sweet lime.
3 A kind of panic seed.
E.
मधु sweet, कै to sound, aff. ड; or मधु honey, कन् aff. of comparison, &c.

m. (-कः)
A tree, (Bassia latifolia.)
E.
मन to respect, ऊक aff., and ध substituted for the final.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Sweet-speaking or sounding.
2 Made from the Bassia tree.
E.
मधूक, and अण् aff.

m. (-ण्ठः)
The Koïl or Indian cuckoo^1.
E.
मधु honey, (as sweet,) कण्ठ the throat.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-रः)
1 A bee.
2 A lover.
3 A plant, (Achyranthes aspera.)
4 A fruit, the round sweet lime.
E.
मधु honey, and कर what makes.

f. (-का)
1 A sort of citron, the round sweet lime.
2 A kind of date.
E.
मधु honey, and कर्क्कटी or कर्क्कटिका a cucumber; some authorities have मधुकुक्कुटिका in place of this word.

m. (-री)
A bee.
E.
मधु, and कारिन् who makes.

m. (-टः)
A bee.
E.
मधुके in honey, and शट to go, aff. अच्.

m. (-कृत्)
A bee.
E.
मधु honey, and कृत् what makes.

m. (-षः)
The honeycomb or hive.
E.
मधु honey, कोष receptacle.

Tippling.
2

The honeycomb.
E.
मधु wine or honey, and क्रम order, arrangement.

m. (-रः)
The date tree.
E.
मधु honey, and क्षीर milk.

m. (-नः)
A tree, (Hyperanthera morunga.)

m. (-षः)
The Koïl or Indian cuckoo.
E.
मधु sweet, and घोष voice.

n. (-जं)
Bee's wax.
f. (-जा)
1 The earth.
2 Clayed or candied sugar.
E.
मधु honey, and ज produced.

m. (-जित्)
VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA.
E.
मधु the demon so named, and जित् conqueror.

n. (-णं)
Sugar-cane.
E.
मधु sweet, and तृण grass.

m. (-पः)
KĀMA, the Hindu CUPID.
E.
मधु spring, and दीप inflaming.

m. (-तः)
The mango tree.
E.
मधु spring, and दूत messenger; blossoming in spring.

m. (-द्रः)
A bee.
E.
मधु honey, द्रु to take, क aff., and the vowel changed.

m. (-वः)
A red variety of the Hyperanthera morunga.
E.
मधु honey, and द्रव dropping.

m. (-मः)
A tree, from the blossoms of which a spirit is distilled, (Bassia latifolia.)
E.
मधु wine, and द्रुम a tree.

m. (-तुः)
A sort of pyrites.
E.
मधु honey, (as yellow,) and धातु mineral, honey-stone.

f. (-लिः)
Molasses, sugar before it is quite purified.
E.
मधु honey, and धूलि dust.

m. (-कः)
A sweet kind of cocoanut.
E.
मधु sweet, नालिकेरक cocoanut.

m. (-ता)
A bee.
E.
मधु honey, नी to get, तृच् aff.

m. (-हः)
A bee.
E.
मधुनः of honey, लेह who licks.

m. (-पः)
A bee.
E.
मधु honey, and प who drinks.

n. (-र्कं)
A dish of curds, ghee, and honey, to be offered to a respectable guest on his arrival.
E.
मधु honey, पृच to sprinkle, aff. घञ्.

f. (-का)
1 The indigo plant.
2 A tree, (Gmelina arborea.)
3 Moon plant, (Asclepias acida.)
4 A creeper of the cryptogamia class, (Lycopodium imbricatum, Rox.)
5 A shrub, (Menispermum glabrum.)
E.
मधु honey, पर्ण a leaf, aff. कन्, fem. form; also मधुपर्णी.

f. (-र्णी)
1 A sort of creeper, (Menispermum glabrum.)
2 A tree, (Gmelina arborea.)
3 The indigo plant.
4 The sweet lime.
E.
मधु honey, पर्ण the leaf, aff. ङीष्.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
Living on honey.
m. (-यी)
A bee.
E.
मधु honey, पा to drink, णिनि aff., and युक् augment.

f. (-का)
A tree, (Gmelina arborea.)
E.
मधु honey, पाल to nourish, वुन् aff., fem. form.

f. (-री)
Mathurā, a city so called.
E.
मधु the Rākṣasa killed by ŚATRUGHNA, and पुरी city or capital.

m. (-ष्पः)
1 A tree, (Bassia latifolia.)
2 The Mimosa Śirīṣa.
3 The Bakul, (Mimusops elengi.)
E.
मधु wine or honey, and पुष्प flower.

m. (-यः)
1 A shrub, (Ardisia solanacea.)
2 A name of BALARĀMA.
E.
मधु wine, &c., and प्रिय fond of.

m. (-लः)
1 A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta.)
2 A sweet kind of cocoanut.
E.
मधु honey, and फल fruit.

mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
Sweet, honied.
f. (-ती)
A species of the Uṣṇih metre.
E.
मधु, and मतुप् aff.

m. (-भिट् or -भित्)
A name of KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU.
E.
मधु the Daitya, and भिट् destroyer.

f. (-का)
A bee.
E.
मधु honey, and मक्षिका a fly.

m. (-नः)
A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
मधु the Daitya, and मथन destroyer.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Sweet, luscious.
E.
मधु, and मयट् aff.

f. (-ल्ली)
Double jasmine.
E.
मधु honey, and मल्ली jasmine.

n. (-कं)
A sweetmeat made of flour, honey, oil, and ghee.
E.
मधु honey, and मस्तक a head.

m. (-कं)
A spirit distilled from the flowers of the Bassia latifolia.
E.
मधु spirit, and माध्वीक the same.

n. (-लं)
An esculent root, a sort of yam.
E.
मधु spirit, and मूल root.

f. (-ष्टिः)
Sugar-cane.
E.
मधु honey, and यष्टि a cane or stick.

f. (-का)
Liquorice, (Glycirrhiza glabra, or rather the Abrus precatorius, of which the root is similarly used.)
E.
मधु honey, यष्टि a stick, and कन् added; or without the aff. मधुयष्टी f. (-ष्टी)

Sweet.
2

Pleasing, agreeable, liked.
m. (-रः)
1 The sweet taste, sweetness.
2 A drug, commonly Jīvaka.
n. (-रं)
1

Poison.
2

Tin.
3

Treacle, syrup.
f. (-रा)
1 A sort of fennel, (Anethum sowa or panmorium, Rox.)
2 Anise, (Pimpinella anisum.)
3 A plant, (Sanseviera zeylanica.)
4

Liquorice.
5

The sweet lime.
6

Marrow.
7
The city

Mathurā.
8
A medicinal plant, commonly

Kakkoli.
9

Asparagus racemosus.
10 Bengal beet.
E.
मधु honey, and रा to get or be, aff. क; to have the flavour of honey, to be as sweet.

n. (-रं)
Arabian jasmine or its flower.
f. (-री)
1 Spirituous or vinous liquor.
2 Sweetness of temper, amiableness.
E.
मधुर sweet, &c., aff. अण् and ङीष्.

m. (-कः)
A medicinal plant, commonly Jīvaka.
E.
मधुर the same, and कन् added.

m. (-कः)
A sort of fish.
E.
मधुर sweet, and कण्टक bone.

m. (-रः)
The sweet lime.
E.
मधुर sweet, जम्बीर lime.

m. (-चः)
A shrub, (Grislea tomentosa.)
E.
मधुर sweet, त्वच् bark, अच् added.

f. (-ना)
A woman with a sweet voice.
E.
मधुर sweet, निस्वन who sounds.

m. (-रः)
The sweet lime.
E.
मधुर sweet, वीजपूर a citron.

m. (-सः)
1 Sweetness, (in flavour.)
2 Sweetness, (in speech.)
3 The sugar-cane.
4 The palm tree.
f. (-सा)
1 A shrub, (Sanseviera zeylanica.)
2 A plant, (Asclepias acida.)
E.
मधु wine or honey, and रस juice, flavour.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Sweet, mellifluous, mellow, melodious.
E.
मधुर, and अक्षर a letter.

m. (-कः)
The hog plum, (Spondias mangifera.)
E.
मधुर sweet, अम्ल sour, कन् aff.

f. (-पा)
The talking Maina, (Turdus salica.)
E.
मधुर sweet, आलाप talking, fem. form.

f. (-का)
A sort of fennel, (Anethum sowa, Rox.)
E.
मधुरा the same, कन् aff.; this name is applied also to the Anethum panmorium, Rox. and the Bengali derivative Mahuri is applied to common anise.

m. (-पुः)
A name of KṚṢṆA.
E.
मधु the demon, and रिपु foe.

m. (-कः)
The sea of fresh or sweet water, surrounding Puṣkara dvīpa, and being the outermost of the seven seas.
E.
मधुर sweet, and उदक water.

n. (-लं)
Spirituous or vinous liquor.
E.
मधु wine, ला to be or get, aff. क.

m. (-लः)
A sort of Bassia described as growing in watery or mountainous situations.
f. (-ली)
1

Liquorice.
2

The sweet lime.
3 The mango tree.
4 A plant, (Sanseviera zeylanica.)
E.
मधु honey or spirit, ला to be or get, aff. ड, and the उ of मधु irregularly long.

m. (-लिड्-लिट्)
A bee.
E.
मधु honey, लिह् to lick, aff. क्विष्.

m. (-हः)
A bee.
E.
मधु, and लेह what licks.

m. (-ही)
A bee.
E.
मधु honey, लिह to lick, aff. णिनि

m. (-नः)
The Koïl or Indian cuckoo.
E.
मधु sweet, and वन who speaks or cries.

m. (-रः)
Tippling, drinking frequently and repeatedly.
E.
मधु wine, वार quantity.

m. (-जः)
The pomegranate.
E.
मधु sweet, वीज seed.

m. (-तः)
A bee.
E.
मधु honey, व्रत observance.

m. (-खः)
Bassia latifolia.
E.
मधु spirituous liquor, शाखा a branch.

m. (-खः)
KĀMADEVA.
E.
मधु spring, and सख for सखि friend.

m. (-ग्रुः)
A red variety of the Hyperanthera morunga.
E.
मधु sweet, and शिग्रु the same tree.

f. (-णी)
A plant, (Sanseviera zeylanica.)
E.
मधु honey, श्रेणी a line or row.

m. (-लः)
A tree, (Bassia latifolia.)
E.
मधु spirit, ष्ठीव to eject, aff. क, and ल substituted for the final.

m. (-यः)
KĀMADEVA.
E.
मधु, and सहाय friend.

ind.
As honey, sweet.
E.
मधु, and साति aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Become sweet.
E.
मधुसात्, and भूत become.

m. (-थिः)
KĀMA the Hindu CUPID.
E.
मधु the spring personified, and सारथि a charioteer, having Vasanta or spring for his coachman.

m. (-क)
A sort of poison.
E.
मधु honey, and सिक्थक wax.

m. (-हृद् or -हृत्)
KĀMADEVA.
E.
मधु spring, सुहृत् the friend.

m. (-नः)
A name of VIṢṆU.
f. (-नी)
Bengal beet.
E.
मधु the Daitya or honey, and सूदन destroyer.

m. (-वाः)
A tree, (Bassia latifolia.)
E.
मधु spirituous liquor, स्रु to drop or distil, aff. असुन्.

f. (-वा)
1 A plant, (Celtis orientalis.)
2 Liquorice.
E.
मधु honey, स्रु to drop, aff. अप् and टाप्.

m. (-रः)
The Koïl or Indian cuckoo.
E.
मधु sweet or spring, and स्वर note, song.

m. (-हा)
A name of KṚṢṆA.
E.
मधु the Daitya, and हन् destroyer.

n. (-ष्टं)
Bee's wax.
E.
मधु honey, and उच्छिष्ट left, rejected.

n. (-घ्नं)
The city Mathurā.
E.
मधु the demon, उपघ्न destruction.

mfn. (-लकः लिका-लकं)
Sweet.
m. (-कः)
1 A sort of Bassia, growing in watery or mountainous sites.
2 Sweetness.
f. (-लिका)
A plant, (Sanseviera zeylanica.)
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं)
1 Middle, intermediate.
2 Right, proper, reasonable.
3 Low, vile.
4 Amongst, amidst.
5 Mean, (in astronomy,) as मध्यछाया middle or mean shadow.
mn. (-ध्यः-ध्यं)
1 The west.
2 Mean or common time in music.
3 The middle, the centre.
4 The waist.
f. (-ध्या)
1 A young woman, a girl arrived at puberty.
2 The middle finger.
3 A form of metre, a stanza of four lines containing three syllables in each.
m. (-ध्यः)
Cessation, rest, interval.
n. (-ध्यं)
1 A very large number, ten Āntyas.
2 A horse's flank.
E.
मां beauty, धा to have, अण् aff., deriv. irr.

mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं)
Middle, mid (day).
E.
मध्य, and अण् added.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
Who or what goes in the centre or betwixt, amongst, &c.
E.
मध्य, and ग what goes.

m. (-न्धः)
The mango tree.
E.
मध्य middle, and गन्ध smell.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Going amongst or amidst.
E.
मध्य, and चारिन् who goes.

ind.
From or in the middle, centrical, centrically.
E.
मध्य the middle, and तसि aff.

m. (-शः)
The middle region; part of India, bounded by Kurukṣetra on the north, Allahabad on the south, the Himālaya mountains on the east, and the Vindhya mountains on the west; comprising therefore the modern provinces of Allahabad, Agra, Delhi, Oude, &c.; the northern limit is elsewhere defined to be the disappearance of the Sarasvatī.
E.
भध्य middle, and देश country.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
1 Middle, centrical, intervening, intermediate.
2 Middle born, neither the oldest nor youngest.
3 Mean, (in astronomy,) as मध्यमगति mean motion (of a planet.)
mn. (-मः-मं)
The waist, the middle of the body.
m. (-मः)
1 One of the seven musical notes, the fifth note of the Hindu gamut.
2 The middle country: see मध्यदेश.
3 A sort of deer.
4 One of the Grāmas or musical scales of the Hindus, corresponding apparently with the major mode of European music.
f. (-मा)
1 A girl arrived at puberty, or in whom menstruation has commenced.
2 The middle finger.
3 A central blossom.
4 A form of metre, a verse of four lines of three syllables each.
E.
मध्य middle, and म aff.

mfn. (-मः-मी-मं)
Middle born.
E.
मध्यम the same, अण् pleonasm.

m. (-वः)
ARJUNA, the third or middle of the PĀṆḌU princes.
E.
मध्यम middle, and पाण्डव Pāṇḍava or descendant of PĀṆḌU.

m. (-कः)
The earth, the world of mortals.
E.
मध्यम middle, and लोक world; between heaven and hell.

m. (-कः)
A husbandman.
E.
मध्यम middle, and भृतक a labourer; working partly for his own advantage, and partly for that of the landlord.

mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं)
Middle, aged.
E.
मध्यम, and वयस्क aged.

m. (-हः)
Intriguing with another man's wife, the act of presenting flowers, perfumes, &c. to her, and conversing with her privately.
E.
मध्यम middle, संग्रह connexion.

n. (-सः)
1 Punishment due to crimes of a middling degree.
2 Injuring buildings, throwing down walls, &c.
E.
मध्यम middle, साहस violence.

f. (-का)
A girl arrived at puberty, one in whom menstruation has commenced.
E.
मध्यमा the same, कन् added, in the fem. form.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Central, middle.
E.
मध्यम middle, and छ aff.

m. (-वः)
A weight of six white mustard seeds.
E.
मध्य middle, and यव barley-corn, the Yava being sometimes considered equal to eight seeds.

m. (-त्रः)
Midnight.
E.
मध्य middle, रात्र night, and the masculine form in the compound.

m. (-कः)
The earth, the dwelling of mortals.
E.
मध्य middle, and लोक world; placed in the middle between heaven and hell; also with कन् added मध्यलोकक.

m. (-शः)
A king, a sovereign.
E.
मध्यलोक the earth, and ईश sovereign.

mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति)
1 Central, middle.
2 Being amongst or amidst.
m. (-र्त्ती)
A mediator.
E.
मध्य, and वर्त्तिन् who abides.

n. (-त्तं)
The navel.
E.
मध्य the middle, and वृत्त abiding.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
Centrical, middle.
m. (-स्थः)
A middle man, an umpire, an arbitrator, a mediator.
E.
मध्य middle, and स्थ what or who stays.

n. (-स्थं)
1 Middle state or condition.
2 Indifference to earthly objects.
E.
मध्यस्थ, and अण् aff.

f. (-ता)
1 Middle state or character.
2 Indifference.
E.
मध्यस्थ middle, and तल् aff. of the abstract; also with त्व, मध्यस्थत्व n. (-त्वं)

n. (-लं)
The waist.
E.
मध्य middle, स्थल place or part.

m. (-ह्नः)
Midday, noon.
E.
मध्य middle, अहन् a day.

m. (-लः)
Tippling, drinking repeatedly.
E.
मधु wine, अल to be equal to, aff. अच्.

m. (-तः)
Taste or touch of honey.
E.
मधु, and आपात alighting.

n. (-कं)
Sweet potatoe.
E.
मधु sweet, आलु an esculent root, कन् added.

m. (-वः)
A spirituous liquor, distilled from the blossoms of the Bassia latifolia.
E.
मधु the Bassia, and आसव spirit.

m. (-कः)
A distiller.
E.
मध्वासव spirit, नी to go, aff. क, form irr.

f. (-जा)
Spirituous liquor.

mfn. (-वः-वी-वं)
Made of honey, &c.
m. (-वः)
1 A name of KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆ
The month

Vaiśākha.
3

Spring.
f. (-वी)
1 Sugar, clayed or candied.
2 A large creeper, (Gærtnera racemosa.)
3 Spirituous liquor.
4 A bawd.
5 A sort of dentifrice, commonly

Misi.
6

Sacred basil.
7 A name of DURGĀ.
n. (-वं)
Sweetness.
E.
मधु honey, &c., and अण् aff. of derivation or reference.

m. (-कः)
A spirituous liquor, made from the blossoms of the Bassia latifolia.
f. (-विका)
1 A kind of creeper.
2 A female attendant.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

f. (-ता)
A large creeper bearing white fragrant flowers, (Gærtnera racemosa.)
E.
माधवी the same, and लता a creeper.

f. (-ष्टा)
A name of DURGĀ.
E.
माधव, and इष्ट wished.

f. (-री)
The alms obtained from five places by the third class of religious mendicants.
E.
मधुकर a mendicant, अण् aff.

m. plu. (-ताः)
The people of Kashmir.

n. (-र्य्यं)
Sweetness of flavour or disposition.
E.
मधुर sweet, literally or figuratively, aff. ष्यञ्.

n. (-स्थ्यं)
Mediation, intercession.
E.
मध्यस्थ, and ष्यञ् aff.

m. (-कः)
Spirit distilled from the flowers of the Bassia.
E.
मधु Bassia, अण् aff., and कन् added.

f. (-ध्वी)
1 Spirituous liquor.
2 A sort of fish.
E.
मधु sweet, q. v., अण्, and ङीष् aff.

n. (-कं)
1 Spirituous liquor, distilled from the blossoms of the Bassia latifolia.
2 Wine, spirit distilled from grapes.
E.
माध्वी as above, कन् added.
